primary.$description: Primary CTAs and interactive elements. Most important action on screen. Never use decoratively.

destructive.$description: Destructive or irreversible actions. Always pair with a confirmation dialog.

success.$description: Positive confirmations, completed states. Never decorative.

warning.$description: Cautionary states needing attention. Not errors.

danger.$description: Errors and critical alerts. Always pair with a non-color indicator for accessibility.

primary.$description: Main body copy on light surfaces.

inverse.$description: Text on dark or colored backgrounds only.

raised.$description: Cards and floating elements above the default surface.
